rationales: The nucleolus is the site where ribosomal subunits are produced and assembled.
A nucleoid is the region containing DNA in prokaryotic cells, not where ribosomes are synthesized.
The endoplasmic reticulum may have ribosomes attached, but it does not synthesize them.
Chromatin is DNA and associated proteins, not the site of ribosome synthesis.
Bacterial cells divide by binary fission rather than mitosis.
Germ cells produce gametes through meiosis, although their precursors may undergo mitosis.
Prokaryotic cells do not undergo mitosis because they lack a nucleus.
Mitosis is the division process typically occurring in somatic cells.
An activator increases enzyme activity but is not the molecule the enzyme acts on.
An inhibitor reduces enzyme activity rather than serving as the molecule acted upon.
A substrate is the molecule on which an enzyme acts.
Products are formed from substrates during an enzyme-catalyzed reaction.
Albumin helps maintain blood osmotic pressure but does not cause clotting.
An antigen is a substance that can trigger an immune response, not a clotting protein.
Fibrinogen is converted into fibrin during blood clotting.
Haemoglobin transports oxygen in red blood cells rather than helping blood clot.
C₂H₄O₂ is the formula of acetic acid, not lactic acid.
Lactic acid has the molecular formula C₃H₆O₃.
C₆H₁₂O₆ is the formula of glucose.
C₆H₂₂O₁₁ is not the formula of lactic acid.
Energy is released when the terminal phosphate bond between phosphate groups in ATP is hydrolyzed.
A carbon–hydrogen bond is not the bond whose hydrolysis releases ATP's usable energy.
A carbon–nitrogen bond is not the bond responsible for ATP's energy release.
A carbon–oxygen bond is not the bond responsible for ATP's energy release.
The liver does not convert ammonia into an amino acid as its main detoxification process.
Acetic acid is not the less toxic form into which the liver converts ammonia.
The liver converts toxic ammonia into the less toxic substance urea.
Bile juice aids digestion and is not the product of ammonia detoxification.
The jejunum is generally described in this syllabus as about 2.5 m long.
The jejunum is not generally given as 2.7 m in the textbook measurement.
The expected textbook length of the jejunum is 2.5 m.
The jejunum is not generally given as 2.4 m in the textbook measurement.
Parasitology is the study of parasites.
Zoology is the broader study of animals.
Entomology is the study of insects.
Ecology studies relationships between organisms and their environment.
Jabir Bin Hayan is associated with chemistry, not commonly honoured as the founder of medicine.
Bu Ali Sina, also known as Avicenna, is honoured as the founder of medicine.
Abdus Salam was a physicist, not the founder of medicine.
E. Chattian is not the person honoured as the founder of medicine.
“Mala” does not mean good; the Latin word for good is “bona.”
“Mala” is Latin for bad.
“Mala” does not mean water.
“Mala” does not mean stagnant.
Caesalpino called his fifteen plant groups classes.
Species are individual kinds of organisms, not the name he gave those groups.
Genera is the plural of genus and was not the term used for his fifteen groups.
Order is a taxonomic rank, but Caesalpino called his groups classes.
A photograph is a general image and does not specifically mean an image made through a microscope.
A micrograph is an image or photograph produced using a microscope.
A telegraph is a communication device or message, not a microscope image.
A cardiograph records heart activity rather than producing a microscope image.
Spindle fibres begin to form during prophase.
Anaphase is when chromatids separate and move toward opposite poles.
Metaphase is when chromosomes align at the cell's equator after spindle formation.
Telophase is when nuclei reform and the spindle breaks down.
Lipase breaks down fats, not protein stains.
Amylase breaks down starch, not protein stains.
Pepsin digests proteins in the stomach but is not the general detergent enzyme used for protein stains.
Protease enzymes break down proteins and are used to remove protein stains from clothes.
